title: Sandbox escape via runInContext (javascript) — review required
description: The javascript call runInContext runs code inside a context. Contexts are not security boundaries, so untrusted input becomes execution. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms trust or removes it via isolated workers or no eval.
remediation: Remove or use isolated workers or no eval.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any runInContext call matches.
